## Overview participating centers

```{r tablecenter, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, caption = "Details of participating centers. OR: operating room."}
knitr::kable(
    setting[c("center.id", "or.id", "anaesthesia.machine", "water.trap")],
    col.names = c("Center", "OR", "Anaesthesia machine", "Water trap")
)
```

```{r table-center-or, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
or_tbl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
    split(agcs, agcs$or),
    function(x) {
        fin <- x[is.na(x$exclusion.reason), ]
        data.frame(
            center       = x$center[1L],
            or           = x$or[1L],
            n.agcs.total = nrow(x),
            n.agcs.final = nrow(fin),
            n.cases      = if (nrow(fin) > 0L) sum(fin$n.cases) else 0L,
            n.bottles    = if (nrow(fin) > 0L) round(sum(fin$avg.bottles), 1) else NA_real_,
            water.trap   = ifelse(x$water.trap[1L] == 1, "Yes", "No"),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
    }
))
or_tbl <- or_tbl[order(or_tbl$center, or_tbl$or), ]
rownames(or_tbl) <- NULL

knitr::kable(
    or_tbl,
    col.names = c("Center", "OR", "AGCs deployed", "AGCs analysed",
                  "Cases", "Bottles (est.)", "Water trap"),
    caption = paste0(
        "Canisters deployed and analysed by centre and operating room. ",
        "AGCs deployed: all canisters used during the study period; ",
        "AGCs analysed: canisters included in the final analysis (batch ", zeosys_batch, "); ",
        "Cases: anaesthesia cases recorded for analysed canisters; ",
        "Bottles (est.): sevoflurane bottles attributed to analysed canisters by proportional allocation."
    ),
    row.names = FALSE,
    na.string = "—"
)
```

## Case mix by canister

```{r case-mix-plot, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3.5, fig.cap = paste0('Proportion of inhalational anaesthesia (blue) and TIVA (red) cases for each of the ', n_agcs['final'], ' analysed canisters, sorted in ascending order of the inhalational anaesthesia proportion. Each bar represents one canister.')}
fa_cm <- agcs[is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason), ]

n_inha_cols <- grep("^n\\.cases.*inha", names(fa_cm), value = TRUE)
n_tiva_cols <- grep("^n\\.cases.*tiva", names(fa_cm), value = TRUE)

n_inha <- rowSums(fa_cm[, n_inha_cols, drop = FALSE])
n_tiva <- rowSums(fa_cm[, n_tiva_cols, drop = FALSE])
n_tot  <- n_inha + n_tiva
n_tot[n_tot == 0L] <- 1L

ord <- order(n_inha / n_tot)

bar_mat <- rbind(
    n_inha[ord] / n_tot[ord] * 100,
    n_tiva[ord] / n_tot[ord] * 100
)

op <- par(mar = c(3.5, 4.5, 0.5, 0.5))
barplot(
    bar_mat,
    beside    = FALSE,
    col       = c(col_primary, col_secondary),
    border    = NA,
    space     = 0.15,
    ylab      = "Proportion of cases (%)",
    las       = 1,
    axisnames = FALSE,
    ylim      = c(0, 100)
)
mtext(
    paste0("Canister (n = ", ncol(bar_mat),
           ", sorted by proportion of inhalational anaesthesia)"),
    side = 1, line = 2.5, cex = 0.9
)
par(op)
legend("bottomleft",
       legend = c("Balanced anaesthesia", "TIVA"),
       fill   = c(col_primary, col_secondary),
       border = NA,
       bty    = "n",
       cex    = leg_cex)
```

## Weight gain by centre

```{r centre-weight-gain-boxplot, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4.5, fig.cap = paste0('Weight gain by participating centre for all ', n_agcs['final'], ' analysed canisters. Boxes show the median and interquartile range; whiskers extend to 1.5 × IQR. Individual data points are overlaid (jittered).')}
wg_box   <- agcs[is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason), ]
ctr_lvls <- sort(unique(wg_box$center))
n_ctr    <- length(ctr_lvls)
ctr_pal  <- setNames(
    palette.colors(n_ctr, palette = "Okabe-Ito")[seq_len(n_ctr)],
    ctr_lvls
)

wg_list        <- lapply(ctr_lvls,
                         function(ctr) wg_box$weight.gain[wg_box$center == ctr])
names(wg_list) <- paste("Centre", ctr_lvls)

op <- par(mar = c(6, 4.5, 0.5, 0.5))
boxplot(
    wg_list,
    col     = ctr_pal[as.character(ctr_lvls)],
    border  = "grey30",
    xlab    = "",
    ylab    = "Weight gain (g)",
    las     = 2,
    bty     = "l",
    outline = FALSE
)
for (i in seq_along(ctr_lvls)) {
    stripchart(
        wg_list[[i]],
        at       = i,
        add      = TRUE,
        vertical = TRUE,
        method   = "jitter",
        jitter   = 0.12,
        pch      = pt_pch,
        col      = adjustcolor(col_ref, alpha.f = 0.5),
        cex      = 0.7
    )
}
par(op)
```

## Weight gain by anaesthesia machine

```{r machine-weight-gain-boxplot, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5.5, fig.cap = paste0('Weight gain by anaesthesia machine for all ', n_agcs['final'], ' analysed canisters. Boxes show the median and interquartile range; whiskers extend to 1.5 × IQR. Individual data points are overlaid; filled circles indicate canisters with a water trap, open circles those without.')}
wg_mach <- agcs[is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason), ]
setting$or_key <- sprintf("%02.f-%02.f", setting$center.id, setting$or.id)
wg_mach$anaesthesia.machine <- setting$anaesthesia.machine[
    match(wg_mach$or, setting$or_key)]

machine_order <- names(sort(tapply(
    wg_mach$weight.gain, wg_mach$anaesthesia.machine, median, na.rm = TRUE)))
wg_mach_list <- setNames(
    lapply(machine_order, function(m)
        wg_mach$weight.gain[wg_mach$anaesthesia.machine == m]),
    machine_order)

set.seed(20260517)
op <- par(mar = c(9, 4.5, 0.5, 0.5))
boxplot(
    wg_mach_list,
    col     = "grey90",
    border  = "grey30",
    xlab    = "",
    ylab    = "Weight gain (g)",
    las     = 2,
    bty     = "l",
    outline = FALSE
)
for (i in seq_along(machine_order)) {
    idx      <- which(wg_mach$anaesthesia.machine == machine_order[i])
    y_vals   <- wg_mach$weight.gain[idx]
    x_vals   <- jitter(rep(i, length(idx)), amount = 0.12)
    pch_vals <- ifelse(wg_mach$water.trap[idx] == 1L, pt_pch, 1L)
    points(x_vals, y_vals,
           pch = pch_vals,
           col = adjustcolor(col_ref, alpha.f = 0.6),
           cex = 0.8)
}
par(op)
legend("topleft",
       legend = c("Water trap", "No water trap"),
       pch    = c(pt_pch, 1L),
       col    = col_ref,
       bty    = "n",
       cex    = leg_cex)
```

## Recaptured sevoflurane by clinical characteristics

```{r supp-boxplot-setup, include = FALSE}
final_agcs$ana.type <- factor(
    ifelse(final_agcs$pct.inha >= 0.5, "Inhaled", "TIVA"),
    levels = c("Inhaled", "TIVA")
)
final_agcs$airway.type <- factor(
    ifelse(final_agcs$pct.tube >= 0.5, "Tracheal tube", "Laryngeal mask"),
    levels = c("Laryngeal mask", "Tracheal tube")
)
final_agcs$surgery.type <- factor(
    ifelse(final_agcs$pct.lap >= 0.5, "Laparoscopic", "Non-laparoscopic"),
    levels = c("Non-laparoscopic", "Laparoscopic")
)
final_agcs$wt.label <- factor(
    ifelse(final_agcs$water.trap == 1L, "With water trap", "Without water trap"),
    levels = c("Without water trap", "With water trap")
)
```

```{r fig-add-01-water-trap, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = paste0("Proportionally allocated recaptured sevoflurane by water trap use for all ", n_agcs['final'], " analysed canisters.")}
.boxjitter(
    split(final_agcs$proportional.recaptured.sevo, final_agcs$wt.label),
    cols = c(col_secondary, col_primary),
    ylab = "Recaptured sevoflurane (g)"
)
```

```{r watertrap-weightgain-test, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
wg_wt_data <- final_agcs[!is.na(final_agcs$weight.gain), ]
wg_wt_grps <- split(wg_wt_data$weight.gain, wg_wt_data$wt.label)

wg_wt_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(wg_wt_grps, function(x)
    data.frame(
        n      = length(x),
        median = round(median(x, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
        IQR    = round(IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
    )
))
wg_wt_summary <- cbind("Water trap" = rownames(wg_wt_summary), wg_wt_summary)
rownames(wg_wt_summary) <- NULL

knitr::kable(
    wg_wt_summary,
    col.names = c("Water trap", "n", "Median weight gain (g)", "IQR (g)"),
    caption   = "Weight gain by water trap use."
)

wg_wt_test <- wilcox.test(weight.gain ~ wt.label, data = wg_wt_data, exact = FALSE)
```

Weight gain was compared between canisters with and without a water trap
using a two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
There was `r if (wg_wt_test$p.value < 0.05) "a statistically significant" else "no statistically significant"`
difference in weight gain between groups
(W = `r round(wg_wt_test$statistic, 0)`,
p `r ifelse(wg_wt_test$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", paste0("= ", format.pval(wg_wt_test$p.value, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)))`).

```{r fig-add-02-anaesthesia-type, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = paste0("Proportionally allocated recaptured sevoflurane by dominant anaesthesia type for all ", n_agcs['final'], " analysed canisters. Canisters are classified as inhaled-dominant if the proportion of inhalational anaesthesia cases is at least 50%.")}

## Effect of water trap on weight difference

```{r watertrap-test, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
wt_data <- agcs[is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason) & !is.na(agcs$weight.diff), ]
wt_data$water.trap <- factor(wt_data$water.trap, levels = c(0, 1),
                             labels = c("No", "Yes"))

wt_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(wt_data$weight.diff, wt_data$water.trap),
    function(x) data.frame(
        n      = length(x),
        median = round(median(x, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
        IQR    = round(IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
    )
))
wt_summary <- cbind(water.trap = rownames(wt_summary), wt_summary)
rownames(wt_summary) <- NULL

knitr::kable(
    wt_summary,
    col.names = c("Water trap", "n", "Median ΔW (g)", "IQR (g)"),
    caption   = "Weight difference (ΔW = W2 − W1) by water trap presence."
)

wt_test <- wilcox.test(weight.diff ~ water.trap, data = wt_data,
                       exact = FALSE)
```

Weight difference was compared between canisters with and without a water trap
using a two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
There was `r if (wt_test$p.value < 0.05) "a statistically significant" else "no statistically significant"`
difference in ΔW between canisters with and without a water trap
(W = `r round(wt_test$statistic, 0)`,
p `r ifelse(wt_test$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", paste0("= ", round(wt_test$p.value, 3)))`).

## Weight loss during storage

```{r weight-loss-storage-setup, include = FALSE}
wl_data             <- agcs[!is.na(agcs$weight.diff), ]
wl_data$weight.loss <- -wl_data$weight.diff

fit_wl  <- lm(weight.loss ~ weight.gain, data = wl_data)
wl_cf   <- coef(fit_wl)
wl_ci   <- confint(fit_wl)
wl_smry <- summary(fit_wl)

## long-format for time-based regression (day 0 = first weighing)
wl_long <- rbind(
    data.frame(agc.id = wl_data$agc.id, day = 0L,                 weight = wl_data$weight1),
    data.frame(agc.id = wl_data$agc.id, day = zeosys_storage_days, weight = wl_data$weight2)
)

fit_wl_time  <- lm(weight ~ day, data = wl_long)
wl_time_cf   <- coef(fit_wl_time)
wl_time_ci   <- confint(fit_wl_time)
wl_time_smry <- summary(fit_wl_time)
```

```{r weight-loss-storage-plot, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4.5, fig.cap = paste0("Weight loss between the first and second ZeoSys weighing as a function of weight gain for all analysed canisters (n = ", nrow(wl_data), "). The line shows the fitted linear regression; the shaded band is the 95% confidence interval.")}
x_seq <- seq(min(wl_data$weight.gain), max(wl_data$weight.gain), length.out = 200)
pred  <- predict(fit_wl,
                 newdata  = data.frame(weight.gain = x_seq),
                 interval = "confidence")

plot(
    wl_data$weight.gain, wl_data$weight.loss,
    xlab = "Weight gain (g)",
    ylab = "Weight loss during storage (g)",
    pch  = pt_pch,
    col  = adjustcolor(col_primary, alpha.f = pt_alpha),
    las  = 1,
    bty  = "l"
)
polygon(
    c(x_seq, rev(x_seq)),
    c(pred[, "lwr"], rev(pred[, "upr"])),
    col    = col_band(),
    border = NA
)
lines(x_seq, pred[, "fit"], col = col_primary, lwd = 2)
```

Weight loss during storage was modelled by linear regression of the absolute weight difference (W1 − W2)
on canister weight gain.
The estimated weight loss per gram of weight gain was
`r round(wl_cf["weight.gain"], 3)` g
(95% CI `r round(wl_ci["weight.gain", 1], 3)` to `r round(wl_ci["weight.gain", 2], 3)`),
and the intercept was
`r round(wl_cf["(Intercept)"], 2)` g
(95% CI `r round(wl_ci["(Intercept)", 1], 2)` to `r round(wl_ci["(Intercept)", 2], 2)`);
R² = `r round(wl_smry$r.squared, 2)`.


## Linear regression

```{r linear-regression, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
fit_lm <- lm(
    proportional.recaptured.sevo ~ 0 + .,
    data = as.data.frame(cbind(
        proportional.recaptured.sevo = Y,
        X
    ))
)

knitr::kable(
    as.data.frame(summary(fit_lm)$coefficients),
    digits = 4,
    caption = paste0(
        "Linear regression coefficients (OLS, no intercept) for the prediction of ",
        "recaptured sevoflurane (g) from anaesthesia case characteristics. ",
        "R² = ", round(summary(fit_lm)$r.squared, 3), ", ",
        "adj. R² = ", round(summary(fit_lm)$adj.r.squared, 3), "."
    )
)
```

## Penalised regression diagnostics

```{r penalized-regression-plot, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Cross-validation curve for the penalised regression model (LASSO, alpha = 1). Dotted vertical lines indicate lambda.min and lambda.1se."}
plot(fit)
```

```{r penalized-regression-path, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Regularisation path of the LASSO model. Each line represents one predictor."}
plot(fit, "path")
```

```{r pred-vs-obs, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 5, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "Predicted versus estimated recaptured sevoflurane per canister for the primary LASSO model at lambda.1se. The predicted value is the LASSO fitted value; the y-axis shows the proportionally allocated outcome (not a direct measurement). The dashed line is the identity line (perfect prediction)."}
pred_lasso <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newx = X, s = "lambda.1se"))
r2_pvo     <- round(cor(pred_lasso, Y)^2, 2)
lim        <- range(c(Y, pred_lasso))

plot(
    pred_lasso, Y,
    xlim = lim,
    ylim = lim,
    pch  = pt_pch,
    col  = adjustcolor(col_primary, alpha.f = pt_alpha),
    xlab = "Predicted recaptured sevoflurane (g)",
    ylab = "Estimated recaptured sevoflurane (g)",
    las  = 1,
    bty  = "l"
)
abline(0, 1, lty = 2, col = col_ref)
legend("topleft",
       legend = bquote(R^2 == .(r2_pvo)),
       bty    = "n",
       cex    = leg_cex)
```

## Predictor correlations

```{r predictor-correlations, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6.5, fig.cap = paste0("Pairwise Pearson correlations among the ", length(clustering_columns), " predictor variables. Predictors with zero variance are excluded. Rows and columns are ordered by hierarchical clustering (correlation distance). Blue: positive correlation; red: negative correlation. Abbreviations: n, case count; dur, cumulative duration; flow, median fresh gas flow; LM, laryngeal mask; TU, tracheal tube; nl, non-laparoscopic; l, laparoscopic; BA, inhalational anaesthesia; TV, TIVA; WT, water trap.")}
## remove zero-variance columns (e.g. subgroups with no cases across all ORs)
X_var    <- X[, apply(X, 2, var) > 0, drop = FALSE]
cor_mat  <- cor(X_var)

## shorten variable names for display
sn <- colnames(X_var)
sn <- sub("^n\\.cases\\.",  "n.",    sn)
sn <- sub("^sum\\.dur\\.",  "dur.",  sn)
sn <- sub("^med\\.flow\\.", "flow.", sn)
sn <- gsub("\\.nonlap",     ".nl",   sn)
sn <- gsub("\\.lap$",       ".l",    sn)
sn <- gsub("\\.lap\\.",     ".l.",   sn)
sn <- gsub("\\.inha$",      ".BA",   sn)
sn <- gsub("\\.tiva$",      ".TV",   sn)
sn <- gsub("lama",          "LM",    sn)
sn <- gsub("tube",          "TU",    sn)
colnames(cor_mat) <- rownames(cor_mat) <- sn

col_corr <- colorRampPalette(c(col_secondary, "white", col_primary))(100)
hc       <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor_mat))

heatmap(
    cor_mat,
    Rowv    = as.dendrogram(hc),
    Colv    = "Rowv",
    col     = col_corr,
    symm    = TRUE,
    scale   = "none",
    margins = c(8, 8),
    cexRow  = 0.65,
    cexCol  = 0.65
)

## Sensitivity analyses: alternative regression models

Two alternative models were fitted alongside the original LASSO
to assess robustness of the coefficient estimates under different
assumptions about correlated predictors.
The same predictor set and outcome (`proportional.recaptured.sevo`) were used.

```{r alt-models-setup, include = FALSE, cache = TRUE, dependson = "penalized-regression-setup"}
set.seed(20260517)

## Option 1: Elastic Net (alpha = 0.5)
fit_en <- rcv.glmnet(
    X, Y,
    alpha = 0.5, intercept = FALSE, nfolds = nfolds, nrepcv = nrepcv
)

## Option 2: Ridge (alpha = 0) — distributes weight among correlated predictors
fit_ridge <- rcv.glmnet(
    X, Y,
    alpha = 0, intercept = FALSE, nfolds = nfolds, nrepcv = nrepcv
)
```

    "LASSO (original)"        = fit,
    "Elastic Net (alpha=0.5)" = fit_en,
    "Ridge (alpha=0)"         = fit_ridge
)

tab_1se <- sapply(models, coef_table, s = "lambda.1se")

        "coefficients using the original ", length(clustering_columns), "-predictor model matrix. ",
        "Left: lambda.min; right: lambda.1se."

)

<!--
## Intercept specification

The primary LASSO model was fitted without an intercept (`intercept = FALSE`).
The rationale is straightforward:
a canister with zero anaesthesia exposure adsorbs no sevoflurane,
so the predicted recapture must be zero when all predictors are zero.
Forcing the regression through the origin reflects this physical constraint.

However, the outcome variable (`proportional.recaptured.sevo`) is not a direct measurement
of adsorption but a value derived by distributing the total batch yield
proportionally across canisters according to their weight gain.
Even a canister with minimal inhalational anaesthesia exposure
will have a positive outcome as long as it shows any weight gain relative to others.
In addition, all canisters adsorb some moisture regardless of volatile anaesthetic exposure,
contributing a non-zero baseline weight gain.
Statistically, constraining the intercept to zero biases all slope estimates
if the true conditional mean does not pass through the origin,
and standard R² values are no longer directly comparable to intercept models.

The table below compares LASSO coefficients with and without an intercept
at both regularisation thresholds.

```{r intercept-setup, include = FALSE, cache = TRUE, dependson = "penalized-regression-setup"}
set.seed(20260517)
fit_int <- rcv.glmnet(
    X, Y,
    alpha = 1, intercept = TRUE, nfolds = nfolds, nrepcv = nrepcv
)
```

```{r intercept-coef, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
coef_noint <- cbind(
    as.matrix(coef(fit,     s = "lambda.min")),
    as.matrix(coef(fit,     s = "lambda.1se"))
)
coef_int <- cbind(
    as.matrix(coef(fit_int, s = "lambda.min")),
    as.matrix(coef(fit_int, s = "lambda.1se"))
)

## align rows: no-intercept model has no (Intercept) row
vars_int <- rownames(coef_int)
coef_noint_aligned <- matrix(
    NA_real_, nrow = nrow(coef_int), ncol = 2,
    dimnames = list(vars_int, c("lambda.min", "lambda.1se"))
)
coef_noint_aligned["(Intercept)", ] <- 0
coef_noint_aligned[rownames(coef_noint), ] <- coef_noint

tab_intercept <- cbind(coef_noint_aligned, coef_int)
colnames(tab_intercept) <- c(
    "no intercept (min)", "no intercept (1se)",
    "with intercept (min)", "with intercept (1se)"
)

knitr::kable(
    tab_intercept,
    digits  = 4,
    caption = paste0(
        "LASSO coefficients (alpha = 1) with and without intercept. ",
        "The no-intercept model (primary analysis) forces predictions through the origin, ",
        "reflecting the physical constraint that zero anaesthesia exposure yields zero recapture. ",
        "The intercept model relaxes this constraint and allows for a non-zero baseline, ",
        "accounting for moisture adsorption and the proportional allocation of batch yield. ",
        "Intercept row shows 0 for the no-intercept model."
    ),
    na.string = "—"
)
```

<!--
## Aggregated predictor model

To address the small sample-to-predictor ratio of the original LASSO,
we fitted an ordinary least squares (OLS) regression model
using seven pre-specified aggregate predictors
constructed from the original `r length(clustering_columns)` case-characteristic variables.
For each canister,
inhalation predictors were derived by summing case counts and cumulative durations
across all inhalation anaesthesia subgroups
(laryngeal mask/tracheal tube, laparoscopic/non-laparoscopic),
and by computing the duration-weighted mean fresh gas flow over those subgroups.
TIVA predictors were derived analogously.
Water trap use was included as a binary indicator.
No intercept was fitted, consistent with the primary LASSO model.

```{r agg-model-setup, include = FALSE}
dur_inha_cols  <- grep("^sum\\.dur.*inha",  names(final_agcs), value = TRUE)
dur_tiva_cols  <- grep("^sum\\.dur.*tiva",  names(final_agcs), value = TRUE)
flow_inha_cols <- grep("^med\\.flow.*inha", names(final_agcs), value = TRUE)
flow_tiva_cols <- grep("^med\\.flow.*tiva", names(final_agcs), value = TRUE)
n_inha_cols    <- grep("^n\\.cases.*inha",  names(final_agcs), value = TRUE)
n_tiva_cols    <- grep("^n\\.cases.*tiva",  names(final_agcs), value = TRUE)

wa <- function(flow_cols, dur_cols, dat) {
    ## duration-weighted mean flow; 0 if no duration
    flows <- dat[, flow_cols, drop = FALSE]
    durs  <- dat[, dur_cols,  drop = FALSE]
    total_dur <- rowSums(durs)
    ifelse(total_dur > 0,
           rowSums(flows * durs) / total_dur,
           0)
}

agg <- data.frame(
    n.cases.inha  = rowSums(final_agcs[, n_inha_cols]),
    sum.dur.inha  = rowSums(final_agcs[, dur_inha_cols]),
    med.flow.inha = wa(flow_inha_cols, dur_inha_cols, final_agcs),
    n.cases.tiva  = rowSums(final_agcs[, n_tiva_cols]),
    sum.dur.tiva  = rowSums(final_agcs[, dur_tiva_cols]),
    med.flow.tiva = wa(flow_tiva_cols, dur_tiva_cols, final_agcs),
    water.trap    = final_agcs$water.trap,
    outcome       = final_agcs$proportional.recaptured.sevo
)

fit_lm_agg <- lm(outcome ~ 0 + ., data = agg)
ci_agg     <- confint(fit_lm_agg)
coef_agg   <- summary(fit_lm_agg)$coefficients

agg_tab <- data.frame(
    Predictor = rownames(coef_agg),
    Estimate  = round(coef_agg[, "Estimate"],   3),
    CI.low    = round(ci_agg[, 1],              3),
    CI.high   = round(ci_agg[, 2],              3),
    SE        = round(coef_agg[, "Std. Error"], 3),
    p         = coef_agg[, "Pr(>|t|)"]
)
agg_tab$p.fmt <- ifelse(
    agg_tab$p < 0.001, "< 0.001",
    ifelse(agg_tab$p < 0.01,  paste0("= ", round(agg_tab$p, 3)),
    paste0("= ", round(agg_tab$p, 2)))
)
```

```{r agg-model-table, echo = FALSE}
knitr::kable(
    agg_tab[, c("Predictor", "Estimate", "CI.low", "CI.high", "SE", "p.fmt")],
    col.names = c("Predictor", "Estimate (g)", "95% CI lower", "95% CI upper", "SE", "p"),
    caption   = paste0(
        "OLS regression with seven aggregated predictors (no intercept). ",
        "Outcome: estimated recaptured sevoflurane per canister (g). ",
        "R² = ", round(summary(fit_lm_agg)$r.squared, 3), ", ",
        "adj. R² = ", round(summary(fit_lm_agg)$adj.r.squared, 3), ". ",
        "95% confidence intervals from the t-distribution."
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
)
```

## Weight gain: lowest versus highest TIVA proportion

```{r add-tiva-comparison-setup, include = FALSE}
tiva_sorted <- final_agcs[order(final_agcs$pct.inha), ]

.tiva_grps <- function(n) {
    hi <- head(tiva_sorted, n)
    lo <- tail(tiva_sorted, n)
    wt <- wilcox.test(lo$weight.gain, hi$weight.gain, exact = FALSE)
    list(
        hi          = hi,
        lo          = lo,
        n           = n,
        wtest       = wt,
        med_lo      = median(lo$weight.gain, na.rm = TRUE),
        med_hi      = median(hi$weight.gain, na.rm = TRUE),
        pct_tiva_lo = round(median(1 - lo$pct.inha) * 100, 0),
        pct_tiva_hi = round(median(1 - hi$pct.inha) * 100, 0)
    )
}

tg20 <- .tiva_grps(20L)
tg40 <- .tiva_grps(40L)

n_comp          <- tg20$n
grp_lo_tiva     <- tg20$lo
grp_hi_tiva     <- tg20$hi
tiva_wtest      <- tg20$wtest
tiva_med_lo     <- tg20$med_lo
tiva_med_hi     <- tg20$med_hi
tiva_med_pct_lo <- tg20$pct_tiva_lo
tiva_med_pct_hi <- tg20$pct_tiva_hi
```

The `r n_comp` canisters with the lowest TIVA proportion
(median TIVA fraction `r tiva_med_pct_lo`%)
had a median weight gain of `r round(tiva_med_lo, 0)` g,
compared with `r round(tiva_med_hi, 0)` g
in the `r n_comp` canisters with the highest TIVA proportion
(median TIVA fraction `r tiva_med_pct_hi`%;
Wilcoxon rank-sum test: p `r format.pval(tiva_wtest$p.value, digits = 2)`).

```{r fig-add-12-tiva-comparison, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = paste0("Weight gain for the ", n_comp, " canisters with the lowest versus highest TIVA proportion.")}
grp_labels <- setNames(
    list(grp_lo_tiva$weight.gain, grp_hi_tiva$weight.gain),
    c(
        sprintf("Lowest TIVA\n(n = %d)", n_comp),
        sprintf("Highest TIVA\n(n = %d)", n_comp)
    )
)
.boxjitter(
    grp_labels,
    cols = c(col_primary, col_secondary),
    ylab = "Weight gain (g)"
)
mtext(
    paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", format.pval(tiva_wtest$p.value, digits = 2)),
    side = 3, line = -1.5, adj = 0.97, cex = 0.85
)
```

```{r fig-add-13-tiva-watertrap, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5.5, fig.cap = paste0("Weight gain for the ", n_comp, " canisters with the lowest and highest TIVA proportion, each split by water trap use.")}
at_pos    <- c(1, 2, 3.5, 4.5)
grp_order <- list(

set.seed(20260528)

)
for (i in seq_along(grp_order))
    stripchart(
        grp_order[i], at = at_pos[i], add = TRUE,

    )
axis(1, at = at_pos,
     labels = paste0(c("No WT", "Water trap", "No WT", "Water trap"),
                     "\n(n = ", ns, ")"),
     tick = FALSE, line = 0.5, cex.axis = 0.85)
mtext("Lowest TIVA",  side = 1, at = 1.5, line = 4.5, cex = 0.95, font = 2)
mtext("Highest TIVA", side = 1, at = 4.0, line = 4.5, cex = 0.95, font = 2)
abline(v = 2.75, lty = 2, col = "grey60")
for (j in 1:2) {
    idx <- if (j == 1L) c(1L, 2L) else c(3L, 4L)
    if (length(grp_order[[idx[1L]]]) >= 2L && length(grp_order[[idx[2L]]]) >= 2L) {
        p_val <- wilcox.test(

        )
    }
}

at_pos    <- c(1, 2, 3.5, 4.5)
grp_order <- list(
    tiva_wt_40[tiva_wt_40$tiva.group == "Lowest TIVA"  & tiva_wt_40$water.trap == 0L, "weight.gain"],
    tiva_wt_40[tiva_wt_40$tiva.group == "Lowest TIVA"  & tiva_wt_40$water.trap == 1L, "weight.gain"],
    tiva_wt_40[tiva_wt_40$tiva.group == "Highest TIVA" & tiva_wt_40$water.trap == 0L, "weight.gain"],
    tiva_wt_40[tiva_wt_40$tiva.group == "Highest TIVA" & tiva_wt_40$water.trap == 1L, "weight.gain"]
)
ns <- sapply(grp_order, length)

set.seed(20260528)
op <- par(mar = c(6.5, 4.5, 1.5, 0.5))
boxplot(
    grp_order, at = at_pos, xlim = c(0.5, 5),
    col    = c(col_secondary, col_primary, col_secondary, col_primary),
    border = "grey30",
    ylab   = "Weight gain (g)", xaxt = "n",
    bty    = "l", outline = FALSE
)
for (i in seq_along(grp_order))
    stripchart(
        grp_order[i], at = at_pos[i], add = TRUE,
        vertical = TRUE, method = "jitter", jitter = 0.1,
        pch = pt_pch, col = adjustcolor(col_ref, alpha.f = pt_alpha), cex = 0.8
    )
axis(1, at = at_pos,
     labels = paste0(c("No WT", "Water trap", "No WT", "Water trap"),
                     "\n(n = ", ns, ")"),
     tick = FALSE, line = 0.5, cex.axis = 0.85)
mtext("Lowest TIVA",  side = 1, at = 1.5, line = 4.5, cex = 0.95, font = 2)
mtext("Highest TIVA", side = 1, at = 4.0, line = 4.5, cex = 0.95, font = 2)
abline(v = 2.75, lty = 2, col = "grey60")
for (j in 1:2) {
    idx <- if (j == 1L) c(1L, 2L) else c(3L, 4L)
    if (length(grp_order[[idx[1L]]]) >= 2L && length(grp_order[[idx[2L]]]) >= 2L) {
        p_val <- wilcox.test(
            grp_order[[idx[1L]]], grp_order[[idx[2L]]], exact = FALSE
        )$p.value
        mtext(
            paste0("p = ", format.pval(p_val, digits = 2)),
            side = 3, at = mean(at_pos[idx]), line = 0, cex = 0.8
        )
    }
}
par(op)
